description:
Read a PDF from a URL as text, page by page, with its title, author and page count. Works on text-layer PDFs up to 25 MB and 300 pages; scanned PDFs without a text layer are refused at no charge.

$0.005 USDC per call over x402. Failed calls cost nothing. Call without `payment` to get a quote.

max_pages.description: Read at most this many pages (default 50).

payment.description: Base64 x402 payment payload. Omit it to receive a quote; sign that and call again.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of a PDF.

name: pdf_to_text
title: PDF to text
